verdict.rationale: Plaid is an API-first platform with an official Node SDK, so it can be driven programmatically without a UI. Its free Sandbox supports all API functionality, and the Sandbox-only /sandbox/public_token/create endpoint creates test Items without going through the Link UI, which lets automated test flows run headlessly. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation guidance, an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
